title: Solana-based DeFi platform Drift warns users about an "active attack" on its protocol; Arkham data said over $250M had moved from Drift to an interim wallet (Helene Braun/CoinDesk)
summary: Helene Braun / CoinDesk: Solana-based DeFi platform Drift warns users about an “active attack” on its protocol; Arkham data said over $250M had moved from Drift to an interim wallet — The platform halted deposits while it investigates suspicious activity and urges users to proceed with caution.
